                                                                                                                          22 April 2026




FLASH CONSUMER CONFIDENCE INDICATOR FOR THE EU AND EURO AREA
In April 2026, DG ECFIN's flash estimate of the consumer confidence indicator
continued its free fall since the start of the Iran war in both the EU (-4.0 percentage
points (pps) compared to March) and the euro area (-4.2 pps). At -19.4 (EU) and -20.6
(euro area) points, consumer confidence scores significantly below its long-term average,
reaching its lowest level since the turn of 2022/23.
